transport.diagnostics: optional array; DraftError defaults to []; generic ValueError/HTTP guards/CAS do not receive fabricated diagnostics

diagnostic.targetRule: Only validated unique exact identities and declared parameters/ports are attached. Never parse labels or English strings. Global/schema/budget/invalid or duplicate identity have no nodeId. Invalid endpoints have edgeId/endpoint only. Unknown parameters have no field target. More than one missing port has portIds without portId.
diagnostic.expectedMeaning: The consuming module contract, or the first merge input used as equality contract. Ranges/allowed-ranks/dtypes are explicit objects or arrays.
diagnostic.actualMeaning: The corresponding upstream declaration or inferred declared tensor property; not a runtime observation. Arbitrary invalid parameter values are not echoed.
diagnostic.message: Chinese advice; module kind and parameter names are data; display labels are absent.
diagnostic.technical: Preserved English contract text; arbitrary display labels remain JSON text.
